question_en: Among RJF, PYPL, MA and MSCI, which spent the most on property and equipment in fiscal 2024, and how do the four rank?
question_vi: Trong RJF, PYPL, MA và MSCI, công ty nào chi nhiều nhất để mua sắm tài sản và thiết bị trong năm tài chính 2024, và thứ hạng của cả bốn ra sao?
reference_answer: PayPal (PYPL) spent the most, $683 million on purchases of property and equipment in fiscal 2024, followed by Mastercard (MA) at $474 million, Raymond James (RJF) at $205 million of additions to property and equipment, and MSCI at $33,762 thousand of capital expenditures.

question_en: In the MD&A of their fiscal 2025 10-Ks, which of CCI, REG, PSA and HST discuss buying back their own shares under a program?
question_vi: Trong phần MD&A của báo cáo 10-K năm tài chính 2025, công ty nào trong CCI, REG, PSA và HST có đề cập đến việc mua lại cổ phiếu của chính mình theo một chương trình?
reference_answer: Yes for Regency Centers (REG), Public Storage (PSA) and Host Hotels (HST); no for Crown Castle (CCI), whose passage covers its dividend and does not mention a buyback program. REG notes $200.1 million paid in 2024 under its prior program, PSA has a program for up to 35,000,000 shares (none bought in 2025), and HST repurchased 13.1 million shares in 2025 for $205 million.
evidence_quotes: During 2024, we paid $200.1 million to repurchase 3,306,709 shares of our common stock under our prior stock repurchase program.
Our Board has authorized a share repurchase program pursuant to which management may purchase up to 35,000,000 of our common shares on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions.
We did not repurchase any common shares in 2025.
In 2025, we repurchased 13.1 million shares at an average price of $15.68 per share, exclusive of commissions, for a total of $205 million, under our share repurchase program.

question_en: Which of DOV, VRT, MMM and FAST had the biggest total assets at the end of fiscal 2021? Rank all four.
question_vi: Trong DOV, VRT, MMM và FAST, công ty nào có tổng tài sản lớn nhất vào cuối năm tài chính 2021? Hãy xếp hạng cả bốn.
reference_answer: 3M (MMM) was largest with total assets of $47,072 million at December 31, 2021, then Dover (DOV) at $10,403,627 thousand, Vertiv (VRT) at $6,939.6 million and Fastenal (FAST) at $4,299.0 million.

question_en: What was Altria's gross margin in Q2 2023, meaning the three months ended June 30?
question_vi: Biên lợi nhuận gộp của Altria trong quý 2 năm 2023, tức ba tháng kết thúc ngày 30 tháng 6, là bao nhiêu?
reference_answer: Altria's gross margin was 57.7% in Q2 2023: gross profit of $3,757 million on net revenues of $6,508 million for the three months ended June 30, 2023.

question_en: For fiscal 2021, which of ALGN, WAT, MRNA and MTD booked the highest sales, and what is the order of all four?
question_vi: Trong năm tài chính 2021, công ty nào trong ALGN, WAT, MRNA và MTD có doanh thu cao nhất, và thứ tự của cả bốn ra sao?
reference_answer: Moderna (MRNA) was highest with total revenue of $18,471 million in fiscal 2021, then Align (ALGN) at $3,952.6 million of net revenues, Mettler-Toledo (MTD) at $3,717,930 thousand of total net sales and Waters (WAT) at $2,785,874 thousand of total net sales.
evidence_quotes: During the year ended December 31, 2021 and 2020, we recognized $3,952.6 million and $2,471.9 million of net revenues, respectively, of which $481.1 million and $341.9 million was included in the deferred revenues balance at December 31, 2020 and December 31, 2019, respectively.

question_en: By what percent did NRG's capital spending change in Q1 2023 compared with Q1 2022?
question_vi: Chi tiêu vốn của NRG thay đổi bao nhiêu phần trăm trong quý 1 năm 2023 so với quý 1 năm 2022?
reference_answer: NRG's capital expenditures rose 136.7%, from $60 million in the three months ended March 31, 2022 to $142 million in the three months ended March 31, 2023.
